limits: Fixed inspected three-module candidate correspondence, not a production arbitrary-PE parser
Native dumpbin only reads images; no candidate code invoked or installer run
Names/ordinals/export RVAs do not prove ABI, minimum compiler version, dynamic imports, loader search/API-set/UCRT resolution or clean deployment
Physical186 PE scan; compressed ASAR payloads and optional ARM64/WinPTY execution not accepted
Linker version fields are observations, not established compiler/runtime minimums
